title: CVE expert intermediate assessment
description: One source-bound document per chunk. Cross-document identity, coverage, array-length and assembly-preservation checks are additional validation gates.

input_checksum.description: Exact source-byte SHA-256 supplied by trusted server metadata.

output_schema_checksum.description: Shared final result.json checksum, not the role-specific schema checksum.

ai_cve_ids.description: Unique CVE IDs explicitly supported by the source commit subject or body under the source-message-only policy. External records may verify these candidates, not introduce additional IDs. An empty array means no supported match was identified, not proof that no vulnerability exists; an omitted commit is unassessed.

ai_cve_probabilities.description: Integer confidence percentages from 0 to 100 that each corresponding CVE matches this commit, not severity or product exploitability. Preserve positional correspondence and equal length with ai_cve_ids; both arrays are empty when no supported match is identified. Do not imply external verification when search was unavailable.
